timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,340 KRW/USD (late 1340s range)

WHY: The won is currently strong (requiring only ~1,340 KRW per USD), meaning your monthly $2,000 conversion is expensive in won terms right now. News reports highlight significant exchange-rate volatility rather than a favorable trend, with the rate fluctuating in the mid-1300s range and uncertainty around US long-term interest rates and the upcoming FOMC decision creating unpredictability.

TIP: Given the volatility and current strong won, consider splitting your monthly $2,000 purchase into smaller weekly or bi-weekly conversions to average out the timing risk, rather than converting a large lump sum when the rate is unfavorable.
